newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Habitat sells properties for NZ$1.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: Habitat sells properties for NZ$1.2 mln.

text.p: Property developer Habitat Group said on Monday it had sold its properties at 201 and 205 The Terrace and 5 and 6 Athol Crescent in Wellington for NZ$1.2 million.
The offer was unconditional, but Habitat shareholders would be asked to approve the transaction by July 21, the company said in a statement.
An initial 10 percent deposit had been paid.
Settlement would occur six weeks after the contract is declared unconditional by Habitat, with the balance of the purchase price payable in cash.
"The sale of these properties will result in an increase in net shareholders fund of $299,000," Habitat said.
